description: A listing that did not reach the end of the corpus. `max_notes` is 2 against three notes, so the scan stopped early. Nothing about the candidate list would show it: the two notes that were read are read correctly and rank correctly. The truncation is therefore stated — outcome `partial`, `listing_truncated` in the diagnostics, coverage partial in health — because a caller who reads a short list as the whole corpus has been told a false absence.
